top.line: An agentic team's token bill is mostly a design choice.
top.para: Files as memory, caching, code, the right model, no pasting, static outputs, counting.

in-short.line: Design, files and caching, code and models, no pasting, static outputs, and what we sell.

design.line: Most of the bill is design; dollars are API-equivalent.
design.para: The companion to stop copying and pasting.

files.line: State in files and hand-overs instead of long conversations.
files.para: Storm Charles: 106 hand-overs across 147 session keys.

cache.line: Keep rules and briefs stable to be served from cache.
cache.para: 98.7% of 3.84 billion tokens were cache reads.

code.line: Code for what repeats; a model only for judgement.
code.para: 398 ms for a code step; $0.0002 for a model call.

models.line: Small models for loops, frontier models for decisions.
models.para: $0.068 on open models against $1.99 on Sonnet.

paste.line: Pasting context pays for the same tokens again and again.
paste.para: Lanes and files send only what is needed.

static.line: Static sites cost nothing when people read them.
static.para: A model at reading time is a deliberate feature.

count.line: An accountant agent read cost per role every three hours.
count.para: 924 on the busiest day, then 300 to 500.

sell.line: AgentiCCells sets up teams with these workflows.
sell.para: Saving people's time and tokens together.

limits.line: Our runs; API-equivalent dollars; list-price comparison.

sources.line: Storm Charles, the Swarm demo, PrompTugal.news's accountant.
